narr: Deep monsoon moisture led to heavy rainfall and some areas of flash flooding.
ev: Flooding was reported via AZ511.com on the I-17 Southbound lanes near Stoneman Lake Rd.
A USGS stream gauge on Tonto Creek above Gun Creek (TNRA3) reported a 2 foot rise after heavy rainfall upstream earlier in the morning.
The USGS stream gauge on Cataract Creek below Heather Wash measured a 2.8 foot rise in one hour due to upstream heavy rainfall.
Public reported a minor debris flow in the gully crossing Control Road (FS 64) after heavy rain fell on the West Fire scar.
Public reported 2 feet of water in Webber Creek with debris from the West Fire scar after heavy rain fell on the scar.
